faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Associate-1 position at IISER Tirupati?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Research Associate-1 position at IISER Tirupati is 18th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate-1 post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. degree in chemistry to be eligible for the Research Associate-1 position at IISER Tirupati.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate-1 recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate-1 position is 40 years. There are no specific minimum age requirements mentioned.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-1 role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 42,000 to Rs. 58,000 per month, plus 10% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Research Associate-1 position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an online interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive at IISER Tirupati.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job at IISER Tirupati?
faq.answer: The Research Associate-1 position is a contract-based job. The duration of the contract is not specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are needed when applying via email?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with your application.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IISER Tirupati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Tirupati is located in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q10. What is the tentative interview date for the Research Associate-1 position?
faq.answer: The tentative interview date for the Research Associate-1 position is 21st September 2026. Candidates should be prepared for an online interview.
